### fx.moveRegions

Move paint by stable label ID, composite overlapping pieces by depth, and mask newly exposed pixels.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `labels` | `raster` | Required | stable ID · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":-1,"max":4294967295} |
| Input | `transforms` | `array<record>` | `[]` | {"items":"record","maxItems":65536,"entries":"Records with id, offset (pixels), pivot (pixels), angle (radians), scale, depth and opacity."} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"background":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":-1,"max":4294967295,"integer":true},"default":0},"keepUnlabeled":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"filter":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["nearest","linear"]},"default":"nearest"}} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `labels` | `raster` | — | stable ID · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":-1,"max":4294967295} |
| Output | `gaps` | `raster` | — | byte coverage · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"min":0,"max":255} |

- Labels and paint must share the same grid. Output is clipped to that grid.
- Lower depth is in front. Equal depths put the greater ID in front. Omitted IDs stay in place.
- Gaps are lost alpha at originally painted, labeled pixels after compositing all pieces.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#pixel-effects-and-raster-analysis), [guide](../raster-region-move.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fx.moveRegions --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fx.paletteCycle

Rotate independently timed palette slots while preserving the index raster.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `palette` | `palette` | Required | {"minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"entries":"RGB integer, #rrggbb or normalized RGB triple"} |
| Input | `cycles` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `alpha` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"}} |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |
| Output | `indices` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `palette` | `palette` | — | {"minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"entries":"RGB integer, #rrggbb or normalized RGB triple"} |

- Each named cycle uses an inclusive range, ordered slots or palette role with a period in seconds.
- Cycles cannot overlap. Optional aligned alpha is in byte levels. The output index values never change.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#pixel-effects-and-raster-analysis), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#cycle-an-indexed-palette)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fx.paletteCycle --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fx.relight

Transfer colored raster emission onto a masked receiver with optional normals and height.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `emission` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `normals` | `any` | `null` | view XYZ, +Y up · {"channels":[3,4]} |
| Input | `height` | `any` | `null` | art pixels before heightScale · {"channels":[1,1]} |
| Input | `mask` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"radius":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"min":1,"max":256},"default":32},"emitterHeight":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"min":-4096,"max":4096},"default":8},"strength":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":1024},"default":1},"heightScale":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":-4096,"max":4096},"default":1},"normalEncoding":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["signed","rgb8"]},"default":"signed"},"emissionEncoding":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["srgb","linear"]},"default":"srgb"},"emissionScale":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0.0000152587890625,"max":65536},"default":255},"maskScale":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0.0000152587890625,"max":65536},"default":255},"sampleStep":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":1,"max":32,"integer":true},"default":1}} |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |
| Output | `irradiance` | `linearRaster` | — | linear sRGB light · {"channels":[3,3],"finite":true,"alpha":[0,1],"min":0} |
| Output | `intensity` | `raster` | — | linear relative luminance · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"min":0} |

- All rasters use one aligned art grid of up to 1,048,576 pixels.
- Samples use 3D distance falloff and diffuse facing. Height supplies elevation and generates normals when none are connected.
- Dense emission can pool adjacent source pixels with sampleStep to stay within the 64 million light visit budget.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#pixel-effects-and-raster-analysis), [guide](../raster-relight.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fx.relight --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fx.signalRecovery

Respond to signal or tracking loss by holding the last usable frame and relocking on a stable feed.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `fallback` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `available` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| Input | `quality` | `number` | `1` | {"finite":true} |
| Input | `tracks` | `array<record>` | `[]` | {"items":"record"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"loseBelow":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":1},"default":0.4},"lockAbove":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":1},"default":0.65},"lossFrames":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":1,"max":120,"integer":true},"default":2},"lockFrames":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":1,"max":120,"integer":true},"default":3},"blendSeconds":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds","constraints":{"min":0,"max":60},"default":0.2},"trackId":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":1,"max":4294967295,"integer":true},"description":"Require this visible persistent region ID and use its confidence."}} |
| Input | `reset` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| Output | `value` | `any` | — |  |
| Output | `status` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `events` | `array<record>` | — | {"items":"record"} |

- Lock threshold must be at least the loss threshold. Only distinct timestamps advance observation counts.
- A named track that is absent makes the sample unavailable. Value can be null until an image grid is known.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#pixel-effects-and-raster-analysis), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#recover-from-signal-loss)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fx.signalRecovery --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fx.tileAttributes

Color a one-bit layer with paintable tile palettes and prioritized coverage writes.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `palette` | `palette` | Required | {"minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"entries":"RGB integer, #rrggbb or normalized RGB triple"} |
| Input | `writes` | `array<record>` | `[]` | {"items":"record"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"tileSize":{"type":"number\|vec2","description":"Positive integer width and height in art pixels.","default":8},"defaults":{"type":"record","description":"Base ink slot, paper slot and optional priority.","default":{"ink":1,"paper":0}},"cells":{"type":"array<record>","description":"Paint edits by zero-based tile coordinate.","default":[]}} |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#pixel-effects-and-raster-analysis), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#paint-tile-color-attributes), [guide](../tile-attributes.md)
